text:
Marta Ruiz: Quick heads-up: product wants unversioned tokens to route to v2 by default. Need to decide per-route opt-outs, quota projection, and console preview ASAP.
Noah Kim: Strong +1 for per-route opt-out. /v1/embeddings behavior differs and customers will break if we flip globally.
Jae Lee: Telemetry first: we should run a 24h shadow for a small sample of tenants and emit metrics: redwood.migration.{tenant,route}.{v1_count,v2_count,token_delta,fallbacks}. Tag with shadow_run_id.
sre-bot: alert-rule suggestion: if tenant_fallback_rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m -> page oncall and disable auto-switch for that tenant.
Marta Ruiz: Console preview: three numbers per-tenant per-route: est monthly cost delta, est p95 latency delta, % prompts with template mismatch. Add "Run shadow now" action.
Noah Kim: Quota calc: persist a "shadow_estimate" override so billing reflects projected tokens during migration preview. Avoid surprise invoices.
Jae Lee: Routing semantics: respect explicit `x-client-version` header first, then token metadata, then tenant compat flag. Provide opt-exempt toggle `compat.exempt` in console for enterprise.
sre-bot: deploy-note: migration-shadow v0.1 deployed to staging.
Marta Ruiz: Action items: Noah - shadow metric names + dashboard mock (due Mon). Jae - route-manager enum and header handling (due Fri). SRE - runbook for fallback circuit (due Tue).
